description:
Reads the project's statistics catalog conditionally by version.
Use when: showing counter labels, modes, reset policies and optional report bounds.
Not for: loading player counter values; use horizon_get_statistics.
Requires: userId and the player's session: sign in with horizon_signin_email or horizon_signin_anonymous and pass its accessToken as sessionToken.
Side effects: None (read only).
Returns: {definitionVersion, definitions}; definitions null means unchanged, an empty array means an empty catalog.
Errors: 401 SESSION_REQUIRED: sign in again; 403 SESSION_FORBIDDEN: use the matching player. 409 OPERATION_CONFLICT means the ID was already used for a different payload. 410 OPERATION_EXPIRED rejects an expired/evicted unknown ID. Never replace an uncertain ID automatically. 422 UNKNOWN_STATISTIC/UPDATE_ABOVE_LIMIT/VALUE_OVERFLOW rejects the whole batch. Needs HORIZON_API_KEY. Every failure returns an error result (isError) with the HTTP status and body: a 401 that horizon_test_connection also returns means HORIZON_API_KEY is wrong, 429 means the account's per-minute rate limit was reached (wait a minute, then retry).

definitionVersion.description: Last cached definitionVersion; omit to load the full catalog

sessionToken.description: Player accessToken from horizon_signin_anonymous or horizon_signin_email; sent as Bearer
